summary.text: Son of Crotopus and king of Argos in Pausanias' native succession after Crotopus; father of Gelanor, whose claim Danaus contested when he returned from Egypt.
Not Sthenelus son of Capaneus who inherited the Anaxagoras third of Argos after the Epigoni, nor Sthenelus son of Andromeda in the Perseid house — spellings and generations differ.

story.text: Crotopus son of Agenor came to the Argive throne after Iasus and begat Sthenelas. When Danaus landed from Egypt he claimed the kingdom against Gelanor son of Sthenelas; the Argives judged the dispute, and Pausanias says the arguments of Sthenelas were considered as fair as Danaus' own.
